Name: Friendly Statue
Author: mrtaiyou
Description:
[img]https://imgur.com/osmmJIX.png[/img]
[font=Arial]
[/font][size=6] ﻿Friendly Statue, [/size][size=3]a Seasonal Chicken Statue sequel[/size]

A fairly simple mod: gives the Chicken Statue furniture a glow up and make it get a new a seasonal animal look!


[size=5][u]Features:[/u][/size]

[b]Seasonal Changes[/b]

Each season, the Chicken Statue will change to its current season variant. They are refered as other coop animals, such as the Duck, Bunny and Dinosaur. Each variant contains a forageable of the season attached to the statue. This is to highlight the furniture but also make sure it feels more rewarding to have one around your farmhouse!

[b]Statue Name Change[/b]

To make sure these changes feels more fitting, you can also configure how the statue display name will be shown to you. Simply edit the mod config file to adjust it to your preferences:

[u] ﻿Animal Statue[/u] - makes the Chicken Statue contain just "Animal" as prefix, so you don't have to bother with non matching names

[u] ﻿Seasonal Name Change[/u] - makes the statue change its display name over the seasons together with it's look! So for example, having it changing to ﻿"Duck ﻿Statue" when it's summer :)


[size=5][u]Notes:[/u][/size]

This mod has text changes! Translation files are welcome to be sent to me, so I can include them ^^.


[size=5][u]Special Thanks[/u]:[/size]

To Airyn, of course! He's responsible for the mod new code, [s]as the previous SCS mod was lacking immersion haha[/s]. 

﻿I hope you like this surprise, and If you like this mod, don't forget to endorse it!
